records.subject: You're in -- let's get Harbor Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for setting up Harbor Partners on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Project created day 1 (2026-08-22) and 1 invite sent show real momentum, and Jordan replied positively [email:e4f077ee] with no tickets or blockers. But key_milestone is still unreached 6 days in, Jordan deferred the call ("at some point"), and a later nudge [email:e1269212] got no reply — suggesting low urgency with 8 days left.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Harbor Partners' setup
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Glad things are going well — and yes, let's do that walkthrough. Would a short call this week work? I can walk through how your team is using projects and tasks and help get the next piece in place.

For context, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually where a team gets the most out of it early on. If your colleague hasn't accepted the invite yet, an admin can resend an invite at any time.

Just reply with a couple of times that suit you.

Best,
Nadia
